title: Tighten table-only add-on deduction tables at admission (olc5.13 follow-up)
description: Pack validation checks economyDeduction tables only for packs that declare the deduction. A table-only add-on overriding table:cube-of-force-charges-lost with duplicate keys, a non-string key, or a negative amount is admitted by validateRulesPack and is refused only at execution (eshyra-olc5.13.3). Consider validating the effective table at stack resolution so refusals surface at bind time. Execution-side refusal already keeps the database unchanged.
notes: 2026-10-17: PR #668 opened (attempt eshyra-w750.1, 983061e7, captain-verified 6968 passed). Stays in_progress until merge.
